verdict.rationale: Buzz's self-hosting model ('the project lives in one place, and that place is yours', run-your-own-relay, first-class Helm/VPS distributions) gives an operator ultimate control over where data resides and thus indirect control over retention/deletion by managing their own database/infrastructure, and the admin API shows some data-visibility tooling. However there is no documented feature for message/channel/data deletion, configurable retention windows, or a deletion API/command exposed to end users or agents. Missing for 10: explicit data-retention settings, message/channel deletion commands or APIs, and any GDPR-style data-erasure workflow.
